name: Magic Trackpad
author: Drew Purdy
description: Touchpad behaviour in the Omarchy bar. v0.1 reads and sets the libinput touchpad options Hyprland already supports (tap-to-click, two-finger right-click, natural scroll, scroll speed, disable-while-typing, tap-and-drag, middle-click emulation), applied live and persisted, fully reversible. Later versions add finger-swipe gestures, Apple Magic Trackpad Taptic Engine strength, and a custom-gesture daemon.
